title: Fix touchpad not working in GNOME
summary: If your touchpad stops working in GNOME, it might be disabled in the desktop settings. This card shows how to re-enable touchpad events and adjust tapping/scrolling settings via gsettings.
error_patterns: touchpad events are not being sent to the GNOME desktop

steps.explain: Ensure that touchpad events are enabled in GNOME settings.
Optionally, enable tap-to-click if you want to click by tapping the touchpad.
Optionally, disable natural scrolling if you prefer traditional scroll direction.
